Experiment-Agentic-Flow/mepworkspace.purpose: Angular/Nx monorepo for MEP (Mechanical, Electrical, Plumbing) solutions - dozens of apps (hcui, ecui, livecount, fabui, sxui, analytics-portal, admin-assist-portal, asset-iq-portal, ...) and shared libraries under libs/, organized by domain.

projects.name: admin-assist-portal
projects.purpose: Angular/Nx administrative portal for authenticated internal users to view distributor summaries, search distributor branches and companies, inspect company details, extract reports, manage distributor integrations, and retrieve ERP registration data.
notablePatterns: Angular NgModule-based application with lazy-loaded feature modules and route-level authentication guards.
NgRx feature state uses actions, reducers, selectors, facades, and effects for admin assist, login orchestration, ERP registration, distributor onboarding, spinner, and toast messages.
A shared AdminAssistPortalStateService adapts multiple feature-specific state service interfaces to facade observables and commands.
HTTP services use injected environment endpoint tokens and typed request/response models.
Transloco provides runtime localization with locale support and JSON translation assets.
AdminAssistEffects implements distributor-summary caching and paginated report extraction using RxJS expand and reduce.

projects.name: admin-assist-portal-e2e
projects.purpose: Playwright end-to-end tests for the Admin Assist Portal, currently covering authenticated login and app-shell readiness across configured environments.
notablePatterns: Nx run-command targets invoke Playwright for standard, UI, and debug execution, with an ESLint target.
Global setup resolves credentials through Azure App Configuration and Azure Key Vault, writes resolved configuration, and caches Cognito authentication state.
Worker-scoped envConfig and getLogin fixtures provide resolved environment data and login lookup; app fixtures provide HomePage, loggedInContext, and loggedInPage.
Page Object Models inherit from BasePage and use Playwright Locator objects, web-first waits, and role or semantic selectors.
Playwright runs sequentially with one worker to avoid shared authentication-state races and data collisions.
Environment selection is driven by config/app-execution-env.json and environment JSON files for development, staging, and local execution.

projects.name: ai-support-assistant-app
projects.purpose: Angular application that authenticates users via query-string tokens or TPaaS login, captures an agent name, and renders the shared MEP AI chat-bot experience for supported products.
notablePatterns: Standalone Angular components with signal-based local state
Route guards capture agentname query parameters and enforce authenticated access
Login supports accesstoken/token query parameters and authorization-code login
Shared MEP chat-bot and authentication modules are configured through forRoot providers
NgRx root store uses meta-reducers for authentication/chat-bot state persistence and token-clear resets
Transloco loads en-US, en-GB, and French translations from assets

projects.name: analytics-portal
projects.purpose: Angular Construction Analytics portal for authenticated manufacturer, contractor, and internal users, providing role- and feature-based Power BI reports, alerts, profile/company selection, help content, licensing, and data-sharing consent.
notablePatterns: NgModule-based Angular application with non-standalone components and ngx-bootstrap UI modules
Route-level AuthenticationGuard enforcing token validity, licensing, and terms-of-service acceptance
RxJS BehaviorSubject-based StateService exposing authentication, user, customer selection, token, and alert observables
HTTP interceptor adds Bearer tokens only for configured authorized service URLs
Power BI reports are fetched with role/customer-specific embed tokens and refreshed when tokens expire
Report tabs are dynamically built from customer role and feature type, including premium and disabled report states
Environment-specific build file replacements for dev, staging, and production configurations
Data sharing is provided as a configurable forRoot library module with ProfilesService consent relation APIs
Services use Angular HttpClient for authentication, reports, alerts, notifications, customer, user, licensing, and profile APIs

projects.name: asset-iq-portal
projects.purpose: Angular application shell for the Asset IQ Portal, providing authenticated navigation to Home, Document Parsing, and Catalog Share features, plus Login and Transition flows.
notablePatterns: Angular NgModule bootstrap with provideHttpClient, Transloco, NgRx Store, and NgRx Effects.
Lazy-loaded feature modules for login, transition, home, document parsing, and catalog sharing.
Authentication uses shared MEP authentication APIs, an authentication guard, JWT claim decoding, and logout redirects.
Root application layout uses Modus Web Components for the navbar, side navigation, avatar, card, menu, tooltip, and icons.
NgRx meta-reducers synchronize authentication and selected shared feature state with localStorage and clear state on token removal.
Transloco provides browser-language normalization, English fallback handling, and JSON translations from assets/i18n.
Environment-specific development, staging, and production configuration supplies authentication endpoints, OAuth URLs, region, product, and profile settings.

projects.name: building-materials
projects.purpose: Angular application for authenticated Building Materials file processing, including file upload, metadata, mapping, business-rules configuration, raw-data transformation, and matching/comparison workflows.
notablePatterns: Standalone Angular bootstrap with provideRouter and application-level provider configuration.
NgRx feature state and effects are registered by the file-processing route.
Authentication is enforced for file-processing routes with canActivateWithValidAuthentication.
File-processing steps use nested routes under :fileId and canDeactivate guards for mapping and business-rules screens.
NgRx state is synchronized with localStorage and cleared on authentication token removal.
Shared authentication, licensing, feature flags, application settings, navigation, Transloco localization, and Modus web components are configured through dependency injection.
Environment-specific configuration supports dev, staging, production, and production-EU builds.

projects.name: building-materials-publications
projects.purpose: Angular application for authenticated building-material publication file generation, including export creation, monitoring, merging, downloading, and deletion.
notablePatterns: Standalone Angular components with lazy-loaded wizard routing
NgRx feature state using actions, reducer, selectors, effects, and facade
Angular signals and RxJS interop for component state
Authenticated routing with login, logout, and file-generation routes
HTTP interceptors for authentication-related errors, forbidden-access state, and toast notifications
Export status polling every 20 seconds while generation or merging is in progress
File downloads handled as Blob responses and saved with file-saver
Transloco-based runtime localization with en-US, en-GB, and fr languages
NgRx authentication state persisted and rehydrated through localStorage

projects.name: csui
projects.purpose: Maintenance-mode Angular application for defining HVAC construction fabrication standards, including materials, standards, shops, and projects, using shared HVAC features and platform services.
notablePatterns: Standalone Angular root component with shared navigation feature integration
Lazy-loaded routes with authentication, customer/region/terms, shop, project, and feature-flag guards
NgRx effects orchestrate login, session, feature flags, application settings, licensing, terms acceptance, and navigation
NgRx state is synchronized with localStorage and cleared on authentication token removal
Shared HVAC libraries provide most domain functionality; the app wires platform services and navigation
Transloco provides runtime localization with English, German, and French translation assets
Environment-specific build configurations support dev, staging, production, and EU production deployments

projects.name: ctui
projects.purpose: Workbench application for creating and managing assembly libraries used across estimating, project management, modeling, and fabrication workflows.
notablePatterns: Standalone Angular bootstrap with bootstrapApplication and shared feature/data-access modules.
NgRx store and effects coordinate authentication, customer and license selection, terms acceptance, feature flags, application settings, and navigation.
NgRx state is synchronized with localStorage and cleared on authentication token removal.
Route guards protect authentication, customer-region selection, accepted terms, and assembly-builder access; selected features use resolvers and lazy-loaded modules.
Shared workspace libraries provide assembly library, item library, authentication, licensing, navigation, settings, terms-of-service, search, logging, and feature-flag functionality.
Transloco and DevExtreme localization are configured from the selected customer region.
Environment-specific build replacements support dev, staging, production, and EU production configurations.

projects.name: ecui
projects.purpose: ECUI is an Angular/Nx application providing authenticated estimating workflows, including projects, estimates, cost libraries, units, formulas, labor and equipment databases, work breakdown structures, drawings, and graphical takeoff.
notablePatterns: Angular NgModule bootstrap with AppComponent rather than a standalone root component.
Nx application composition using shared domain feature and data-access libraries.
Lazy-loaded routing for graphical takeoff, drawings, settings, terms of service, and error handling.
NgRx root and feature state with effects for authentication orchestration and company setup imports.
Company cost-library and units imports run in parallel and poll backend status until completion or timeout.
Route access combines authentication, application access, and selected customer/region guards.
StateService implementations are registered through useExisting provider aliases for shared library contracts.
Transloco provides runtime localization with English and Dutch translation assets.
ngx-multi-window synchronizes estimate updates and application state across browser windows or tabs.
Environment-specific Angular build configurations replace environment files for dev, staging, and production.
Wijmo and DevExtreme are used for UI controls and grids, with application-level license initialization and styling overrides.

projects.name: ecui-e2e
projects.purpose: Playwright end-to-end test application for ECUI, covering Cognito login, cost libraries, cost library items, estimates, estimate spreadsheet interactions, and API-backed test-data cleanup across configured environments.
notablePatterns: Page Object Models extend BasePage and encapsulate locators and navigation.
Authenticated tests use worker-scoped loggedInContext and loggedInPage fixtures with a shared Cognito session.
Environment configuration and credentials are resolved through Azure App Configuration and Key Vault, with TARGET_ENV and TARGET_URL overrides.
API clients use Playwright APIRequestContext with bearer authentication and non-production host safeguards.
Tests use web-first assertions, spinner/readiness waits, and avoid page.waitForTimeout().
Test resources are cleaned up through per-test API cleanup plus global teardown using persisted runtime IDs.
Playwright is configured for a single Chromium worker to avoid shared-environment data collisions.

projects.name: electricaldomain
projects.purpose: Angular application shell for the Electrical domain, integrating electrical design workflows for supplies, cables, loads, distribution boards, protective devices, bulk editing, control-panel projects, and single-line diagrams.
notablePatterns: Angular NgModule bootstrap with nested route-based domain workflows.
Nx feature and data-access libraries configured through environment-backed forRoot configuration objects.
NgRx root and feature state with router integration, orchestration effects, authentication effects, and LogRocket middleware.
Desktop access-token authentication supporting query-token, external-routing, and interactive login flows.
Transloco runtime localization for English, Dutch, and German, synchronized with DevExtreme locale messages.
Angular route guards protect project and domain routes, with return-url preservation for login redirects.

projects.name: electricaldomain-e2e
projects.purpose: Nx end-to-end test project for the electricaldomain application.
notablePatterns: Implicit dependency on the electricaldomain project.
Development and production e2e configurations use electricaldomain serve targets.
Angular ESLint linting with strict TypeScript and Angular compiler settings.

projects.name: fabui
projects.purpose: Angular/Nx FAB UI application providing authenticated navigation for home, projects, work packages, settings, project editing, 3D viewing, and detached bill-of-materials workflows, with customer/license selection and shared feature integrations.
notablePatterns: Hybrid Angular architecture using a root NgModule alongside standalone components and lazy-loaded route components.
NgRx root and feature state with route-scoped providers for work packages, project models, and assemblies.
Authentication-aware routing with sessionStorage restoration, expiration checks, validation status tracking, and detached-window token handoff.
Reactive navigation menus derived from menu type, feature flags, and Transloco translations.
Angular signals used for responsive layout state, menu expansion, profile dropdown state, and route-loading indicators.
Trimble Modus web components registered at bootstrap and preloaded through ModusPreloadService.
DevExtreme localization and license validation initialized during application startup.
Shared HTTP interceptors, feature-flag, licensing, navigation, settings, API-message, BOM, tags, pick-list, and project data-access integrations.

projects.name: fabui-design
projects.purpose: Corsa FAB UI Angular application providing responsive project management, fabrication workflows, 3D viewing, shop-floor, settings, authentication, licensing, and developer-tool routes.
notablePatterns: Nx-managed Angular application with a legacy AppModule bootstrap and standalone page/layout components.
Lazy-loaded feature routes for home, work packages, workshop overview, shop floor, projects, settings, 3D viewer, focus, and UI demos.
NgRx root and feature state with facades and effects for authentication, licensing, projects, assemblies, BOM, navigation, and session persistence.
Angular signals combined with RxJS observables for layout, navigation, feature visibility, theme, and shop-session state.
Feature-flag and local visibility-preset guards control route access and menu-item visibility.
Modus 2.0 Angular components provide the navbar, side navigation, menus, controls, and application styling.
Responsive navigation changes between mobile overlay and desktop push-sidebar behavior.
Detached BOM routes use opener-aware authentication guards and short-lived session-token handoff through browser storage.

projects.name: fmsconnect
projects.purpose: Integrates Trimble Connect File Management System into the Accubid Anywhere Desktop app, using query-parameter authentication and project selection to embed Trimble's file explorer.
notablePatterns: Angular NgModule-based application with lazy-loaded FMS feature routes
NgRx feature state stores ExplorerConfig and persists authentication/FMS state through localStorage meta-reducers
Access tokens are accepted from accesstoken or token query parameters; projectid is captured into ExplorerConfig
Trimble Connect Workspace API is used to connect an iframe, set tokens, initialize the file explorer, and open selected files
Authentication state and explorer configuration are combined with RxJS and consumed through an abstract StateService
Environment-specific FMS, authentication, region, and deployment configurations use Angular file replacements
Transloco provides localized translations with browser-language selection and fallback handling

projects.name: hangers
projects.purpose: Angular application for configuring and running hanger distribution: users select model elements or systems, choose distribution presets and spacing options, then place calculated hangers through a .NET host bridge and network calculations API.
notablePatterns: NgRx feature state keyed by 'hangers', with actions, selectors, reducer, effects, and facades coordinating initialization, upload polling, prechecks, distribution polling, and model application.

DotNetRequestMessageService bridges Angular UI commands to the host application, including language lookup, model selection, placement, cancellation, transfer status, session lookup, resizing, and applying results.
REST client services use a configurable calculation API URL and a small HttpService abstraction for GET, POST, PUT, and DELETE requests.
Transloco provides runtime localization with English, Dutch, French, Romanian, and German translations; host locale values are normalized to supported language codes.
DevExtreme controls provide selection menus, editable distribution tables, checkboxes, text input, and action buttons; Angular Material supplies the progress spinner.
The UI is organized as a shell containing selection, distribution preset/table editing, spacing options, and place/cancel footer controls.

projects.name: hangers-e2e
projects.purpose: Playwright end-to-end test project for the Hangers application, covering page availability, translated labels, selection controls, distribute-with-equal-distances behavior, selection dropdowns, preset dropdowns, and preset table values and scrolling.
notablePatterns: Custom Playwright test fixture with a configurable url option.
Page Object Model implemented by AppPage with reusable navigation, locator, dropdown, table, hover, and value helpers.
Playwright webServer starts the Nx hangers application with `nx run hangers:serve` on port 4200.
End-to-end tests use Chromium in headless mode with a shared localhost base URL.
Tests validate DevExtreme dropdowns, overlays, checkboxes, and data-grid table contents through CSS selectors.
Preset tests verify DIN EN 10220, DIN EN 1057, and PVC-U DIN 8062 options and their table values.

projects.name: hcui
projects.purpose: Angular/Nx web application for Trimble MEP estimating workflows, including authentication, customer and project management, estimates, graphical and drawing-based takeoff, content libraries, assemblies, favorites, work-breakdown structures, reports, bid breakdowns, and estimate closeout.
notablePatterns: Nx application with Angular NgModule-based bootstrapping and SCSS styling
NgRx root and feature stores with reducers, selectors, effects, facades, and persisted local-storage state
Route guards, breadcrumb resolvers, lazy-loaded feature routes, and route data for navigation configuration
Feature configuration supplied through forRoot modules and application-specific provider tokens
Environment-specific Angular build configurations for local, development, staging, production, and EU deployments
Transloco internationalization with locale synchronization to DevExtreme localization
Multi-window state coordination using ngx-multi-window and browser storage events
Integration with shared estimating, authentication, licensing, navigation, projects, content-provider, drawings, and reporting libraries

projects.name: hcui-e2e
projects.purpose: Playwright end-to-end test suite for the HCUI estimating and takeoff workflows, covering project and estimate lifecycle, grid and graphical takeoff, favorites, assemblies, custom libraries, trade-service items, Trimble recommendations, audit trails, authentication, and environment-specific accounts.
notablePatterns: Standalone Playwright test project managed through Nx targets.
Page Object Models inherit from BasePage and encapsulate HCUI navigation, grids, modals, tabs, panels, and graphical canvas interactions.
Playwright API clients provision and clean up projects, estimates, drawings, layers, favorites, and custom-library data.
Environment configuration is selected from JSON files, with global setup and teardown for authentication and shared-resource lifecycle.
Worker-scoped authenticated fixtures reuse browser state and shared estimates; tests run with one worker and non-parallel execution to avoid shared-data collisions.
Dedicated Playwright projects map EstMep test subdirectories to region/industry accounts such as USPro, USMech, USElec, UKElec, SXUSElec, and SXUKElec.
Seed specifications provision reusable projects, estimates, and drawing-bearing estimates; cleanup fixtures track line items and orphaned projects.
Tests emphasize UI workflows with API-backed setup and teardown, web-first assertions, explicit waits for grids and UI state, and failure artifacts including traces, screenshots, and video.

projects.name: livecount
projects.purpose: Angular/Nx LiveCount application for authenticated estimating workflows, including customer and project selection, job management, drawings, models, graphical and quantity takeoff, attachments, settings, and embedded login.
notablePatterns: Angular NgModule bootstrap with a root AppComponent
Nx feature, data-access, and shared-library composition
Lazy-loaded routes for models, graphical takeoff, quantity takeoff, settings, errors, and detached drawing viewing
Route guards and resolvers enforce authentication, customer, region, project, job, license, drawing, and feature-flag prerequisites
NgRx root store with effects-based login and application orchestration
NgRx state persisted and synchronized through localStorage, including multi-tab storage actions
Angular signals and computed state used alongside RxJS observables
SignalR connection interruption status is debounced and reported through LogRocket
Environment-specific builds support dev, staging, production, migration, and local migration configurations
Transloco provides application-level localization with region-driven locale selection
Feature flags control 3D quantity takeoff, graphical takeoff, AI tools, support assistant context, and other capabilities

projects.name: livecount-studio
projects.purpose: Angular utility application for inspecting and operating LiveCount through legacy HTTP APIs, internal APIs, SignalR or iframe messaging, job management, pagination, authentication, and customer-data administration.
keyModules: access token and JWT claim signals
studio environment URL and authentication configuration
notablePatterns: Standalone Angular components bootstrapped with bootstrapApplication and routed with provideRouter.
Angular signals, computed values, effects, model inputs, outputs, and OnPush change detection are used for state and reactive UI behavior.
Authentication uses Trimble Identity authorization-code redirects, MEP session-token exchange, sessionStorage, JWT decoding, and a route guard based on the access token.
LiveCount communication switches between legacy HTTP, internal REST endpoints, SignalR, and iframe postMessage protocols.
Environment, endpoint, protocol, job, and customer identifiers are selected or persisted through localStorage-backed signals.
Native dialog, iframe, HTML popover, Angular control-flow syntax, and direct fetch calls are used throughout the UI.

projects.name: quick-adds-assistant
projects.purpose: Authenticated Angular application for uploading CSV files, tracking file and result processing, downloading completed outputs, generating analytics reports, and managing training-data reports.
notablePatterns: NgRx feature state uses actions, reducer, selectors, facade, and effects for upload workflows.
Uploads and reports are exposed through authenticated child routes under /uploads.
File transfer uses API-provided Azure Blob SAS URLs with PUT requests.
DevExtreme data grids implement server-side pagination, selection, refresh, download, pause, resume, cancel, and training-data actions.
NgRx local-storage synchronization persists authentication and uploads state, with explicit state reset on logout.
Angular components use RxJS takeUntilDestroyed lifecycle management and Transloco/DevExtreme UI modules.

projects.name: spdui
projects.purpose: Angular desktop-hosted web UI for selecting, creating, and editing Trimble Connect procurement projects, integrated with desktop clients through CefSharp/browser-bridge events and the ExtendedProjectsService API.
notablePatterns: NgModule-based Angular application with a lazy-loaded projects feature route.
NgRx store, reducers, facades, and effects manage authentication and project state.
Authentication supports direct desktop access-token login and interactive Trimble Identity login.
Route guards capture the Connect licenseId and require an access token before loading projects.
Project data is accessed through ExtendedProjectsService procurementprojects endpoints and Trimble Connect project-role endpoints.
Desktop integration uses DotNetRequestMessageService events including OnProjectSelected, OnStartProjectCreate, OnProjectCreated, OnStartProjectEdit, and OnError.
Reactive forms and ManageProcurementProjectService normalize project fields, procurement metadata, users, and yyyy-MM-dd dates.
Authentication and project state are synchronized to localStorage and cleared when the authentication token is cleared.
Transloco provides scoped procurement-project translations for multiple locales.
Environment-specific builds configure API URLs, identity settings, licensing, feature flags, and NA/EU regions.

projects.name: sxmobile
projects.purpose: Angular mobile-first application for product search, project and purchase-list browsing, Quick List management, requisition submission, and requisition tracking.
notablePatterns: Nx layered architecture separates feature, data-access, and model libraries.
NgRx actions, effects, reducers, selectors, and facades manage projects, Quick Lists, requisitions, authentication, licensing, and navigation state.
Route-level authentication guards and resolver services load projects, project lists, and Quick List data.
Angular modules use child route configuration, Transloco localization, DevExtreme UI components, and reactive forms.
Responsive mobile/tablet behavior is handled with BreakpointObserver, window resize detection, and mobile-oriented navigation.
HTTP interceptors surface offline and request failures through CustomToastControlService.
Service worker updates are checked periodically and on navigation, with reload on a ready version.
Selected NgRx state is synchronized with localStorage and cleared on logout.

projects.name: sxui
projects.purpose: Angular application shell for ConstructionXchange, providing authenticated customer, region, and terms-of-service flows plus procurement projects, orders, search, distributor management, job analysis, quotes and orders, price-file processing, and settings.
notablePatterns: NgModule-based Angular application composition with standalone feature libraries
Route guards for authentication, selected customer/region, and accepted terms
Lazy-loaded feature routes for settings, contractor management, job analysis, quotes and orders, price-file processing, and shared application features
NgRx root store and effects for login, session, feature-flag, application-settings, customer, license, and project orchestration
RxJS observable state adapter services exposing facade data and feature-flag streams to feature modules
Environment-specific configuration for dev, staging, EU production, and production builds
Transloco-based root translation loading and locale configuration
Dynamic navigation menus controlled by feature flags and distributor-portal state
HTTP endpoint override tokens collected in AppEndpointModule for local development

projects.name: sysque-electrical
projects.purpose: Angular application providing the SysQue electrical toolbelt, authenticated workspace shell, and routed dialogs for electrical system management, fitting workflows, family information, project data, settings, imports, and gauge takeoff operations.
notablePatterns: Angular NgModule bootstrap with RouterModule and a centralized app route table
Lazy-loaded feature modules for the application shell and routed dialogs
AuthGuard validates query-string or stored JWT access tokens through DotNetRequestMessageService
NgRx feature reducers, effects, facades, and injection tokens manage toolbelt state
Environment-specific builds use file replacements and configuration-data.json service endpoints
DevExtreme, Bootstrap, Modus, Font Awesome, ngx-color-picker, and ng-select are integrated at the application level

projects.name: sysque-electrical-e2e
projects.purpose: Playwright end-to-end test configuration for the sysque-electrical project; the checked-out project contains configuration files but no integration test source files.
notablePatterns: Custom Playwright fixture exposing a required url option
Tests are configured under ./src/integration
Headless Chromium with baseURL http://localhost:4200/
Separate local, dev, stg, and production Playwright projects
Web server command starts the hangers Nx application based on the npm lifecycle project configuration

projects.name: vendorweb3d
projects.purpose: Angular web application that provides contractors access to searchable, downloadable, unlocked plumbing and mechanical component library files, including Revit RFA and Autodesk Fabrication ITM products, with manufacturer browsing, download management, bill-of-materials workflows, support, and license requests.
notablePatterns: Nx layered architecture separates feature, data-access, model, and shared responsibilities.
Angular NgModule bootstrap with routed feature modules for homepage, search, manufacturers, support, and license requests.
NgRx Store reducers, effects, facades, feature keys, and local-storage synchronization manage application and domain state.
Shared authentication, licensing, navigation, application settings, feature flags, terms-of-service, logging, and translation infrastructure are configured at the app shell.
HTTP interceptors handle authentication-related token expiration and application error presentation.
Environment-specific dev, staging, QA, EU production, and production configurations replace API, authentication, licensing, and redirect settings at build time.
Search includes product filtering, tree views, product selection, multi-download tooling, and download notifications.
Shared UI uses reusable popup, download, product, fitting-issue, toast, pipe, and user-settings components.
Transloco provides localized resources for en-US, en-GB, German, and French.
DevExtreme and Trimble Modus web components are integrated into the application.

projects.name: workspace-plugin
projects.purpose: Nx workspace plugin that provides a build-config generator for updating project configuration, ESLint setup, and module specifications.
notablePatterns: Uses Nx Tree-based generators and formatFiles.
Generates project-local ESLint configuration from a template.
Rewrites project.json with generated project metadata and tags.
Updates module specs by replacing async with waitForAsync.
The generator references createProjectBuildAction and getProjectJson, but those source files are absent from the checked-out project.

projects.name: analytics-portal-data-sharing
projects.purpose: Angular library providing a configurable data-sharing consent UI and Profiles API integration for retrieving, creating, and deleting user consent relations.
notablePatterns: NgModule-based library with a forRoot configuration provider
Configurable non-standalone component using Angular inputs, outputs, FormsModule, and ngModel
ProfilesService uses HttpClient for relation filtering, creation, and deletion endpoints
Consent changes delete an existing relation before posting the new accepted or rejected relation
RxJS switchMap and lastValueFrom are used for asynchronous workflows
Component emits separate accept, reject, close, and error events

projects.name: estimate-models
projects.purpose: TypeScript model library for estimating domains, defining content items and components, catalogs, assemblies, company and regional settings, localization records, content providers, and drawing views.
notablePatterns: All public symbols are re-exported through src/index.ts.
The library is tagged as scope:shared and type:model in Nx configuration.
Domain contracts primarily use TypeScript interfaces, classes, type aliases, and enums.
ContentItem and ContentProvider are generic and support typed item properties or provider content.
ContentProvider retrieves content details through an RxJS Observable.
AssemblyType includes a string-to-enum conversion helper that returns undefined for unsupported values.
ContentItem retains a flat property structure while also exposing nested itemProps, explicitly marked as intended for deprecation of the flat structure.
RegionalSettings and its regional subclasses are currently empty and marked for removal.

projects.name: ecui-ui-common
projects.purpose: Shared Angular UI library for ECUI, providing reusable standalone controls, panels, dialogs, filtering, search, table/view management, clipboard, and application UI services.
notablePatterns: Angular NgModule exports many standalone UI components and imports Angular Forms, ReactiveForms, CDK DragDrop, CDK Scrolling, Transloco, Wijmo input controls, and SVG icons.
Simple-controls components intentionally wrap Bootstrap markup with minimal behavior for reuse and easy template customization.
Filtering is modeled through reusable condition classes such as EqualCondition, BetweenCondition, DateAfterCondition, Contains-style conditions, and boolean/empty conditions.
View functionality is represented by typed models and managers for columns, conditions, sorting, grouping, rows, selection, editing, and table state.
Components and supporting classes have extensive co-located Jest specifications.
The public entry point re-exports UI components, services, command infrastructure, view models, spreadsheet clipboard types, modal adapters, and filter models.

projects.name: ecui-ui-common-model
projects.purpose: Shared ECUI model library defining user application settings, grid and filter models, graphical-takeoff options, and DTO mapping for persisted user settings.
notablePatterns: Standalone TypeScript model library with a barrel export in src/index.ts
Primarily uses exported interfaces for persisted application settings
Uses enums for row-height and filter-change classifications
Uses UserAppDataViewModel for conversion to and loading from UserSettingsData DTOs
Composes settings through nested interfaces for search, grid, estimates, cost-library browsing, and page state
Uses index signatures for table-specific closed-state and height settings

projects.name: ecui-utils-common
projects.purpose: Shared ECUI utility library providing Angular directives, pipes, reusable services, field and localization helpers, change tracking, repository lookups, multi-window communication, pagination, and general application utilities.
notablePatterns: Angular NgModule exports reusable directives and pipes and provides CookieService.
Standalone-style Angular directives and pipes are imported directly into UtilsCommonModule.
PaginatedRequestHandler uses RxJS mergeMap concurrency limits to fetch and flatten paginated API results, with separate 1-based and WBS 0-based pagination methods.
MultiWindowManager and TabManager use BroadcastChannel, Angular signals/effects, and parent-child-listener tab roles.
UndoRedoStack supports nested grouped changes through startBlock and endBlock operations.
FieldUtils centralizes locale-aware comparison, field-path access, template-style curly-key resolution, display-name handling, and JSON patch application.
The library includes prototype extension modules for Array, Object, String, and mouse-event helpers.
Most utility classes and Angular artifacts have co-located Jest specifications.

projects.name: ecui-utils-common-model
projects.purpose: Shared model library for ECUI field and column metadata, filtering and sorting criteria, pagination responses, change history, undo/redo operations, value display mappings, and quantity/unit values.
notablePatterns: All public models are re-exported from src/index.ts.
The library is an Nx model-type library tagged scope:ecui-common and type:model.
FieldInfo and SimpleColumnInfo provide constructor defaults based on Wijmo DataType, including alignment and formatting.
FieldInfo.clone performs a property copy and deep-copies ValueToText entries.
ConditionInfo, SortInfo, ColumnInfo, and specialized undoable-change types extend shared base interfaces.
DataType is re-exported from @mescius/wijmo to hide that dependency from consumers.
DataTypeMask uses bit flags to represent sets of Wijmo data types.
Change history models separate rows, sections, entries, grouping, filtering, and display text.
Undo/redo models represent individual changes and explicit start/end block stack entries.
Pagination supports both generic item-count responses and Trimble API-style page links.

projects.name: sld
projects.purpose: Provides an Angular standalone electrical schematic diagram view that loads a project, visualizes its components and connections as a hierarchical network, and navigates to component detail routes.
notablePatterns: Standalone Angular component with external HTML and SCSS
NgRx Store and ProjectFacade for project initialization and fetched-project state
vis-network DataSet and Network for hierarchical component/connection visualization
